capabilities: add copy buttons to headings in the document
copy section content as raw markdown
include or exclude sub-sections below the heading
omit comments and tag-only lines when copying
configure which heading levels show the button
extras: README documents undefined behavior in edge cases where inline comments interact with inline code, matching Obsidian's own inconsistency.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to copy an entire headed section (up to the next header) without manually selecting and copying text.
summary: Editor plugin that adds a copy button to headings so a whole section can be copied to the clipboard as raw markdown.
